description_en: Retrieves terminal information of an edge container application
description_zh: 该接口用于获取边缘容器应用终端信息
name: GetEdgeContainerTerminal

parameters.description_en:
The application ID. You can call the [ListEdgeContainerApps](~~ListEdgeContainerApps~~) operation to obtain the application ID.
<notice>This parameter is required. If this parameter is not specified, the API returns InvalidParameter.appid(400).
Full dependency chain: CreateEdgeContainerApp → CreateEdgeContainerAppVersion → PublishEdgeContainerAppVersion → Wait for the container status to become Running → Call this API.</notice>.
parameters.description_zh:
应用ID，可使用[ListEdgeContainerApps](~~ListEdgeContainerApps~~)接口获取应用ID。
<notice>本参数为必填，未传入时 API 返回 InvalidParameter.appid(400)。
